name: kin-openapi-unified-work-budgets-for-bb0b
instr:
kin-openapi lacks one deterministic, concurrency-safe allowance for bounding cumulative recursive work across OpenAPI loading, validation, conversion, upgrade, Go schema generation, and HTTP validation. Add `WorkBudget` to `github.com/getkin/kin-openapi/openapi3`, atomically reserving named units against `WorkLimits`. Compact inputs cannot evade limits through references, reflection, decoding, or schema traversal. Without a budget, preserve existing results, errors, serialization, writer output, customization, and cycle behavior.

`WorkBudget.Snapshot` returns a deterministic `WorkSnapshot` containing every successful reservation without exceeding any kind or total limit. The first denied reservation changes no counters and returns `WorkLimitError` with its kind, limit, request, and last accepted snapshot. Keep one budget cumulative through root parsing, external reads, new reference expansions, document members, schemas, instance values, reflected types and fields, component publication, and rewrites. Do not charge repeated identities twice.

Loading, validation, `Schema.VisitJSON`, `ConvertToV3`, `UpgradeWithOptions`, and generation stop before denied or later work. Conversion is failure-atomic and preserves shared reference identity. Upgrade denial preserves pre-upgrade observable serialization. Generation never publishes incomplete components. Charge decoded expansion separately from later schema traversal, while keeping reflected-type and runtime-value accounting distinc
